birthday: Today is your birthday. A birthday is a natural checkpoint, whatever the numbers say. Take a few minutes to note what you have learned this year and what you would like the next one to ask of you.
half-birthday: Today is six months from your birthday, which makes it a handy midpoint. Which of the things you hoped for at your last birthday have moved, and which could use a small nudge?
leap-day: Today exists only once every four years. A bonus day can be a small permission to do something you would normally postpone, such as a walk somewhere new, a note to an old friend or an hour with no agenda.
new-years-eve: The last day of the year is a natural moment for closing loops. Choose one thing from the year to finish, one to forgive and one to be glad of, and let the rest wait until tomorrow.
mirror-1-1: A mirror date: the month and the day match, and 1/1 is the first day of the year. Many people use it as a prompt for a fresh start. The calendar is only a calendar, so ask what you would like to begin.
mirror-2-2: A mirror date: 2/2, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 2 with pairing and patience, so use it as a prompt. What could you do with another person today that you usually do alone?
mirror-3-3: A mirror date: 3/3, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 3 with expression, so use it as a prompt. What would you like to say, make or share today, however small?
mirror-4-4: A mirror date: 4/4, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 4 with structure, so use it as a prompt. Which small piece of order would make the coming weeks easier?
mirror-5-5: A mirror date: 5/5, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 5 with change, so use it as a prompt. What small change could you make on purpose today?
mirror-6-6: A mirror date: 6/6, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 6 with care, so use it as a prompt. Who could you look after today, and who could look after you?
mirror-7-7: A mirror date: 7/7, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 7 with reflection, so use it as a prompt. What question could you give ten quiet minutes to today?
mirror-8-8: A mirror date: 8/8, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 8 with effort, so use it as a prompt. What is the one task that, once finished, would lighten the rest of the week?
mirror-9-9: A mirror date: 9/9, where the month and the day match. Numerology links 9 with completion, so use it as a prompt. What is ready to be finished or released today?
mirror-10-10: A mirror date: 10/10, where the month and the day match. The 10 reduces to 1, the number of beginnings, so use it as a prompt. What could you begin from a blank page today?
mirror-11-11: A mirror date: 11/11, where the month and the day match. The tradition marks 11 as a number of heightened sensitivity. Use it as a prompt to notice what you pick up on today, and write down one hunch.
mirror-12-12: A mirror date: 12/12, the last in the run of matching dates. The 12 reduces to 3, the number of expression, so use it as a prompt. What would you like to say before the year closes?
master-11th: The 11th of the month carries the 11, a number the tradition marks as heightened in sensitivity. Whether or not that means anything to you, it can be a prompt: notice what you pick up on today.
master-22nd: The 22nd of the month carries the 22, a number the tradition marks for building on a large scale. Treat it as a prompt, not a rule: what one practical step would move a long-term aim along?
month-start: The first of the month is a natural reset. Take a few minutes to look at the weeks ahead, pick one priority and decide what you want the month to feel like.
month-end: The last day of the month is a natural place to look back. Note what got done, what did not and what you want to carry into next month, without judging yourself.
